title: The Iron in the Furrow
core_theme: The literal emergence of wartime violence through modern agriculture.
narrative_spec: Focus on a farmer plowing a field that was once a historic battlefield. Plow Plow BOOM

title: The Taxonomy of the Inherited Cast-Iron Skillet
core_theme: The molecular accumulation of familial survival.
narrative_spec: Deconstruct a heavy black skillet passed down through four generations. A true test of your ability to extract meaning from anything. Bonus if you make me cry.

title: The Architecture of the Closed Quarry
core_theme: The negative space left behind by structural labor.
narrative_spec: Examine an abandoned stone quarry. Can you make me feel like creating a revolution... or is this just a pond now?

title: The Epistemology of the Unread Diacritic
core_theme: The erosion and preservation of identity through immigrant orthography.
narrative_spec: Analyze a grandmother’s old passport or immigration document where a native name was altered or stripped of its accents by a border official.

title: Inventory of the Displaced Threshold
core_theme: The persistence of home layout in ancestral memory.
narrative_spec: Focus on an individual living in a modern apartment who inherits a vivid, unprompted dream of the spatial layout of an ancestral home they have never seen. Can you turn something this odd into a somatic experience?

title: The Liturgy of the Unmarked Headstone
core_theme: The quiet erasure of marginalized lives from the official landscape.
narrative_spec: Set the poem at the edge of a forgotten cemetery. this prompt is SO melodramatic I will allow for it... THIS ONE ONLY

title: The Foundation-Stone's Cold Equation
core_theme: The structural reliance of modern leisure on historical extraction.
narrative_spec: Explore the basement or foundations of a prestigious university or civic building built with wealth derived from colonial trade or industrial exploitation.

title: The Sexy Librarian
core_theme: The Libraryyyyyyy.
narrative_spec: Try to sympathize with the knowledge of a library, and it's librarians

title: The Sinking of the Homestead Timber
core_theme: The physical decay of rural settlement infrastructure.
narrative_spec: Document a collapsing wooden barn or farmhouse in a prairie landscape.

title: The Dialectics of the Accent
core_theme: The linguistic preservation of regional trauma.
narrative_spec: Analyze the specific phonetic habits, vowel shifts, or idiomatic phrases of a speaker you know well. I want to meet them in your Poem

title: The Taxonomy of the Silk Wedding Shawl
core_theme: The preservation of luxury amidst systemic collapse.
narrative_spec: Examine a fragile, embroidered garment smuggled across a border during a revolution or collapse.

title: The 12:03 Freight Train Requiem
core_theme: The auditory persistence of historical trade routes.
narrative_spec: Listen to the distant howl and vibration of a night freight train passing through a modern suburb. Reframe the version of the train that is past & present

title: The Archive of the Discarded Ledger
core_theme: The cold commercial tracking of human lives as assets.
narrative_spec: Set within a historical archive, examining an old merchant logbook, plantation ledger, or ship manifest ancient or modern.

title: The Rust of the Defunct
core_theme: The ghosting.
narrative_spec: Walk through an abandoned town

title: The Metric of the Inherited Debt
core_theme: The intergenerational transmission of economic gravity.
narrative_spec: Deconstruct the psychological weight of an ongoing ancestral obligation. If you cannot think of one, invent one.

title: The Ghost-Roots of the Orchard
core_theme: The botanical legacy of forgotten agricultural labor.
narrative_spec: Examine a grove of feral apple or olive trees planted by long-dead homesteaders or indigenous farmers.

title: The Protocol of the Shared Recipe
core_theme: The preservation of cultural geometry through salt and heat.
narrative_spec: Document the precise, unwritten instructions for making a traditional dish. chart its survival or its lack of

title: The Calibration of the Old Surveyor’s Chain
core_theme: The arbitrary measurement of property as an enduring boundary.
narrative_spec: Analyze the original layout of a town; was its purpose for business or war, culture or chaos

title: The Silt of the Drainage Ditch
core_theme: The forgotten manual labor that reclaimed the land.
narrative_spec: Set along a massive rural drainage canal that turned wetlands into valuable farmland a century ago; who was paid to do that? Why?

title: The Last Iron Rail at the Port
core_theme: The stubborn survival of the obsolete infrastructure of empire.
narrative_spec: Speak your mind about the way that history has worked so hard to shape us... examine you own feelings about history and its GRAVITAS
